short_summary: Explaining the queue to the new starter

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: Okay, walking you through how checkout handles failures.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: The checkout worker retries three times, then the dead letter queue picks it up.

utterances.speaker: speaker_3
utterances.text: And someone watches the dead letter queue?

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: There is an alarm on depth, it pages the on-call engineer.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: The DLQ on the checkout worker is enabled, so nothing is silently dropped.

utterances.speaker: speaker_3
utterances.text: How often does that actually fire?

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: Maybe twice a month, usually a bad payload.

utterances.speaker: speaker_1
utterances.text: The retry logic lives in the shared messaging library, not in our code.
